data.description: Verify successful Core acceptance executed by the workspace runner: common storage contracts, full Rust regression, actual SQLite/text MCP, write-free reads, adapter parity and independent Git clones. Before execution build with npm run build and cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bins, then run scripts/check_markdown_feature.ps1 -Suite Core -SkipBuild. The installed QA host stalls nested Node/Python startup, so this job checks the resulting complete source path/hash set, binary hashes and retained log hashes; it does not claim to re-execute the suite. Isolated target fixtures only. Server SQL remains unavailable and unvalidated. See docs/markdown-validation.md.
data.name: Markdown storage, MCP and Git acceptance
